name: tinytable-mcp-app
description: Learning prototype: a minimal MCP App (SEP-1865) that shows an editable table in the chat UI.

scripts.start: bun run build && bun run serve
scripts.start:stdio: bun run build 1>&2 && bun run serve:stdio
scripts.dev: NODE_ENV=development concurrently "INPUT=mcp-app.html vite build --watch" "TINYTABLE_LOCAL_FILES=1 bun --watch main.ts"
